startedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the session started.

endedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the session closed, or null/absent while active.

schemaVersion.description: Telemetry schema version for records in this session.

active.description: True while the collector is writing this session.

currentTickSegment.description: Session-relative path to the open tick segment, for example ticks/ticks-000001.jsonl.

currentEventSegment.description: Session-relative path to the open event segment, for example events/events-000001.jsonl.

tickCount.description: Total tick records written by this session.

eventCount.description: Total event records written by this session.

droppedRecords.description: Telemetry records dropped because the writer queue was full.

frameCount.description: Frame files successfully written by this session.

droppedFrameCount.description: Frames dropped because the frame queue was full.

deletedFrameCount.description: Frame files deleted by frame-specific cleanup.

maxFrameStorageMb.description: Active-session frame folder cleanup cap in megabytes.

frameCleanupIntervalSeconds.description: How often active frame cleanup runs.

allowScreenRectangleFallback.description: Whether opt-in screen-rectangle fallback is enabled.

lastUpdatedUtc.description: UTC timestamp of the last manifest write.
